# Tester Exchange

> Gets Android developers the 12 testers × 14 days that Google Play requires before a new personal developer
> account can publish to production. Testers are real people on their own phones; a companion Android app verifies
> each day they opened the app, which is the engagement Google reviews. Pay once (US$9.99 for 12 testers,
> $12.99 for 15, $19.99 for 25; card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay) or get testers free by testing other apps.
> Prices are shown in the visitor's own currency. Site and guides in 18 languages.

## Fastest path for a developer (3 steps)
1. Paste the Google Play link at https://testerexchange.com/ and pick a pack (or test other apps for free).
2. Pay. The test starts automatically when the payment lands.
3. Tap "Connect Google Play": we add our testers group to the app's closed testing track through the Play Developer
   API. Or add it by hand (Play Console → Closed testing → Testers → Google Groups), or use an email list instead:
   we show the tester emails to paste.

## How testers are found (autopilot)
- Nobody browses or picks apps. Free: link a phone with the Tester Exchange app; it is given apps to test
  automatically (paid apps first), and each app you test brings a tester to yours. Paid: skip testing; paid apps get
  testers before anyone else. Google's 14 days apply to everyone.
- Dropouts are replaced automatically; you only pay for verified tester-days and unused credits are refunded.
- After 14 days: a test report with daily activity, tester feedback and draft answers for Google's
  production-access questions.
- Bring your own testers: share https://testerexchange.com/t/<package> with friends; they join free and fill seats.

## For AI agents
- One call does the whole setup: `get_testers` (package_name, name?). It adds the app, opens its test, applies
  credits, and returns the only steps a human must do (add the group in Play Console; pay or link a phone).
  Call it again any time to check progress.
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no OAuth): https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
  Auth: header `Authorization: Bearer tx_…` or `?token=tx_…`. Public tools (about, platform_stats, pricing) work
  without a token. Users create tokens at https://testerexchange.com/api
- HTTP API (one endpoint): POST https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/agent_call
  headers: `apikey: sb_publishable_OwXT7OfwIGkuIn420mavVA_MsAkzZGf` (public key), `Content-Type: application/json`
  body: {"p_token": "tx_…" | null, "p_action": "help", "p_args": {}}
  Actions: help, stats, pricing (public); get_testers (start here), me, my_apps, add_app, start_campaign, campaign,
  add_testers, set_status, friends, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange, join, my_tests, share_kit, buy_credits (token).
- OpenAPI: https://testerexchange.com/openapi.json · Agent docs: https://testerexchange.com/agents/
- What an agent can't do: the 14 days of real use on a phone, and paying (checkout needs a human).

## Facts (October 2026)
- Personal Google Play developer accounts created after 13 Nov 2023 need a closed test with at least 12 opted-in
  testers for 14 continuous days, then apply for production access with a questionnaire.
- The requirement was 20 testers until December 2024.
- Organization (company) developer accounts are exempt.
